mnemonic: 현안 = an 안건 (agenda item) left hanging (현, as in 현수막): a matter waiting to be settled.

examples.ko: 두 장관은 이번 회담에서 무역 분쟁 등 양국 간 현안을 폭넓게 논의했다.
examples.en: At the talks the two ministers discussed a wide range of outstanding issues, including the trade dispute.

examples.ko: 오늘은 다른 건 미루고 당장 급한 현안부터 처리합시다.
examples.en: Today let's set everything else aside and deal with the most pressing issues first.

production.promptEn: a pending / outstanding issue (on the agenda)

mnemonic: 현격하다 has the 격 of 격차 (gap): a gap so wide there's no bridging it. 현격한 차이 = a world of difference.

examples.ko: 두 후보의 지지율 격차가 현격하게 벌어졌다.
examples.en: The gap between the two candidates' approval ratings has widened markedly.

examples.ko: 제도를 도입한 뒤로 사고 건수가 현격히 줄었다.
examples.en: The number of accidents has dropped dramatically since the system was introduced.

production.promptEn: vast / marked (of a gap or difference)

mnemonic: 현수막 = hung up (현) + drooping (수) + curtain (막, as in 개막 'curtain up'): a cloth hung across the street.

examples.ko: 선거철이 되자 거리 곳곳에 후보들의 현수막이 나붙었다.
examples.en: When election season came, candidates' banners went up all over the streets.

examples.ko: 개업 축하 현수막을 가게 앞에 걸어 놨어요.
examples.en: We hung a congratulatory banner in front of the shop for the opening.

production.promptEn: a (hanging) banner, e.g., for an election or event

mnemonic: 거론 = 거수 (raising a hand) + 논의 (discussion): lifting a topic onto the table. 후보로 거론되다 = to be floated as a candidate.

collocations.en: to be floated as a candidate
to be not even worth mentioning

examples.ko: 차기 총리 후보로 서너 명이 거론되고 있다.
examples.en: Three or four people are being floated as candidates for the next prime minister.

examples.ko: 회의에서 그 문제는 아예 거론조차 되지 않았다.
examples.en: The issue wasn't even brought up at the meeting.

production.promptEn: bringing up / mentioning (a topic or a name for discussion)

mnemonic: 열거 = 나열 (line up) + 거론 (raise): line the items up and raise each one.

examples.ko: 그는 회사의 문제점을 하나하나 열거하며 대표의 사퇴를 요구했다.
examples.en: He listed the company's problems one by one and called for the CEO to resign.

examples.ko: 장점만 열거하지 말고 단점도 같이 써 주세요.
examples.en: Don't just list the advantages. Please include the drawbacks too.

production.promptEn: enumeration; listing items one by one

mnemonic: 관행 = 습관 (habit) + 행동 (action): what everyone does out of habit, written rule or not.

examples.ko: 명절마다 협력 업체에서 선물을 받던 관행이 올해부터 금지됐다.
examples.en: The longstanding practice of accepting holiday gifts from partner companies was banned this year.

examples.ko: 다들 관행이라고 하지만 그게 옳다는 뜻은 아니잖아.
examples.en: Everyone says it's just how things are done, but that doesn't make it right.

production.promptEn: an established (often unwritten) practice; custom

mnemonic: 관성 = 습관 (habit) + 성질 (nature): a thing's nature to keep doing what it's already doing.

collocations.en: to keep going out of sheer inertia

examples.ko: 버스가 급정거하자 승객들의 몸이 관성 때문에 앞으로 쏠렸다.
examples.en: When the bus braked hard, inertia threw the passengers forward.

examples.ko: 새 방식이 더 낫다는 걸 알면서도 조직은 관성적으로 예전 방식을 고수했다.
examples.en: Though they knew the new approach was better, the organization clung to the old one out of sheer inertia.

production.promptEn: inertia (in physics, or an organization's habit of doing things the old way)

mnemonic: 묵살 = 침묵 + 살 (kill, as in 살인): killing a proposal with silence.

examples.ko: 노조의 거듭된 면담 요청은 번번이 묵살됐다.
examples.en: The union's repeated requests for a meeting were ignored every single time.

examples.ko: 회의 때마다 내 의견은 묵살당하는 기분이야.
examples.en: It feels like my opinions get brushed aside at every meeting.

production.promptEn: deliberately ignoring / dismissing (a request or opinion)

mnemonic: 묵과 = 침묵 + 통과: letting it pass in silence. (묵인 goes one step further: silently consenting.)

examples.ko: 이번 사태는 결코 묵과할 수 없는 중대한 위반이다.
examples.en: This is a serious violation that can by no means be overlooked.

examples.ko: 작은 비리라고 묵과하다 보면 결국 조직 전체가 무너진다.
examples.en: Let small misconduct slide, and eventually the whole organization collapses.

production.promptEn: overlooking / letting (wrongdoing) pass unchallenged (usually ___할 수 없다)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; written; not the word for tacit approval

mnemonic: 상쇄 has the 상 of 상호 (mutual): two forces wear each other down to zero. Same spelling family as 쇄도; read it 쇄, not 살.

examples.ko: 임금이 올랐지만 물가 상승이 이를 상쇄해 실질 소득은 그대로다.
examples.en: Wages rose, but inflation offset the gain, so real income hasn't changed.

examples.ko: 운동해 놓고 야식 먹으면 다 상쇄되는 거 아니야?
examples.en: If you work out and then have a late-night snack, doesn't it all cancel out?

production.promptEn: offsetting; canceling out
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; 殺 read 쇄 here

mnemonic: 쇄도: everything 도착s (arrives) at once, in a crush. 주문이 쇄도하다 = orders pour in.

examples.ko: 방송에 소개된 뒤로 전국에서 주문이 쇄도하고 있다.
examples.en: Since it was featured on TV, orders have been pouring in from all over the country.

examples.ko: 가격 인상 소식이 알려지자 항의 전화가 쇄도했다.
examples.en: When word of the price hike got out, complaint calls flooded in.

production.promptEn: a flood / rush (of orders, inquiries, or complaints)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun, usually ___하다; 殺 read 쇄

mnemonic: 조율 is what a 조율사 (piano tuner) does: getting every instrument, or every party, to the same pitch.

examples.ko: 양측은 막판까지 세부 조건을 조율하느라 진땀을 뺐다.
examples.en: Both sides sweated over the fine print right up to the last minute.

examples.ko: 다음 주 회의 일정은 제가 각 팀과 조율해서 다시 알려 드릴게요.
examples.en: I'll coordinate next week's meeting time with each team and get back to you.

production.promptEn: coordinating / fine-tuning (schedules, positions); tuning (an instrument)

mnemonic: 조달 = 조정 (arrange) + 배달 (deliver): arranging for what you need to arrive. 자금 조달 = raising funds.

examples.ko: 스타트업은 이번 투자 유치로 약 오십억 원의 자금을 조달했다.
examples.en: The startup raised about five billion won in this funding round.

examples.ko: 부품 조달이 늦어지면서 생산 일정이 한 달이나 밀렸다.
examples.en: Delays in sourcing parts pushed the production schedule back a whole month.

production.promptEn: procurement; raising (funds) / sourcing (materials)

mnemonic: 기조 = 기본 + 어조 (tone): the ground note everything else is played over. 정책 기조 = the basic policy line.

examples.ko: 중앙은행은 당분간 금리 인상 기조를 유지하겠다고 밝혔다.
examples.en: The central bank said it would keep its rate-hiking stance for the time being.

examples.ko: 학회 첫날 기조연설은 노벨상 수상자가 맡았다.
examples.en: A Nobel laureate gave the keynote address on the first day of the conference.

production.promptEn: basic stance / underlying tone (of a policy); keynote
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; economics and policy news

mnemonic: 발탁: pulled out (발, as in 발치 'pulling a tooth') of the crowd and lifted up. 주연으로 발탁되다 = to be picked for the lead.

collocations.en: to be cast as the lead

examples.ko: 신인 배우가 오디션 한 번 만에 주연으로 발탁됐다.
examples.en: A newcomer was cast as the lead after a single audition.

examples.ko: 그는 서른 살에 팀장으로 파격 발탁돼 화제가 됐다.
examples.en: His surprise appointment as team leader at thirty made headlines.

production.promptEn: being picked / singled out (for a role, post, or team)

mnemonic: 발췌: pulling out (발, as in 발치 'pulling a tooth') the best passages of a text.

examples.ko: 보고서 전문 대신 핵심 내용만 발췌해서 공유해 주세요.
examples.en: Instead of the full report, please share just the key excerpts.

examples.ko: 그 기사는 인터뷰 내용을 앞뒤 맥락 없이 발췌해 오해를 낳았다.
examples.en: The article quoted the interview out of context and caused a misunderstanding.

production.promptEn: excerpting; an excerpt (picking out passages)

mnemonic: 간곡히 부탁드립니다: you bow low (곡, as in 곡선 'curve') in earnest as you ask.

examples.ko: 주최 측은 관람객들에게 쓰레기를 되가져가 달라고 간곡히 당부했다.
examples.en: The organizers earnestly asked visitors to take their trash home with them.

examples.ko: 가족들의 간곡한 만류에도 그는 끝내 사표를 냈다.
examples.en: Despite his family's earnest pleas, he handed in his resignation in the end.

production.promptEn: earnest, imploring (of a request or plea)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean adjective; usually 간곡히 + a verb of asking

mnemonic: 간담회 = a 회의 for frank, friendly 담화 (talk). Not the 간담 of 간담이 서늘하다 ('chilled to the bone'), which is liver and gallbladder.

examples.ko: 신임 사장은 취임 첫 주에 직원들과 간담회를 열고 건의 사항을 들었다.
examples.en: In his first week, the new president held a roundtable with staff to hear their suggestions.

examples.ko: 영화 개봉을 앞두고 감독과 배우들이 기자 간담회에 참석했다.
examples.en: Ahead of the film's release, the director and cast attended a press event.

production.promptEn: an informal meeting / roundtable (to talk things over)

mnemonic: 소환 and 소집 share 소, 'call': 소환 summons one person (검찰에 소환되다); 소집 calls everyone together (회의를 소집하다).

examples.ko: 검찰은 다음 주 전 장관을 피의자 신분으로 소환할 예정이다.
examples.en: Prosecutors plan to summon the former minister as a suspect next week.

examples.ko: 그 노래를 들으니까 대학 시절 기억이 소환되는 느낌이야.
examples.en: Hearing that song brings my college days right back.

production.promptEn: a summons; summoning (for questioning)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; legal news, and lately 'bringing back memories'

mnemonic: 소집 = 소 'call' + 집합 'gather': calling everyone together. Summoning one particular person is 소환.

examples.ko: 사고 소식이 전해지자 대표는 임원들을 긴급 소집했다.
examples.en: When news of the accident came in, the CEO called an emergency meeting of executives.

examples.ko: 주말에 갑자기 팀 회의를 소집하는 건 좀 너무하지 않아?
examples.en: Isn't it a bit much to suddenly call a team meeting on the weekend?

production.promptEn: convening / calling (people together for a meeting or duty)

mnemonic: 자의적 = 자기 마음대로, by whatever you feel like. Careful: 자의 alone usually means 'of one's own accord' (자의로 그만두다), a different word.

examples.ko: 법 조항을 자의적으로 해석해 처벌 범위를 넓혀서는 안 된다.
examples.en: Laws must not be interpreted arbitrarily to widen the scope of punishment.

examples.ko: 평가 기준이 너무 자의적이라 직원들 불만이 많다.
examples.en: The evaluation criteria are so arbitrary that the staff are full of complaints.

production.promptEn: arbitrary (decided by whim rather than rule)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean, -적; NOT 自意 (of one's own accord)

mnemonic: 방자하다 has the 방 of 방종 (license): let off the leash, answering to no one.

examples.ko: 그는 윗사람 앞에서도 다리를 꼬고 앉는 등 방자한 태도로 빈축을 샀다.
examples.en: He drew disapproval for his insolence, even sitting cross-legged in front of his superiors.

examples.ko: 권력을 잡자마자 오만방자해진 정치인들을 우리는 여러 번 봐 왔다.
examples.en: We've seen plenty of politicians turn arrogant and insolent the moment they gained power.

production.promptEn: insolent, impudent (behaving without restraint toward others)

mnemonic: 제고 = 높이다 in news-speak: 경쟁력 제고, raising competitiveness. 재고 is either 'think again' or 'stock on hand'; 제고 is the one that raises.

examples.ko: 정부는 중소기업의 경쟁력 제고를 위해 연구 개발 지원을 늘리기로 했다.
examples.en: The government decided to expand R&D support to boost the competitiveness of small and midsize businesses.

examples.ko: 이번 캠페인은 개인 정보 보호에 대한 인식 제고를 목표로 한다.
examples.en: This campaign aims to raise awareness of personal data protection.

production.promptEn: enhancing / raising (competitiveness, awareness, efficiency)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; officialese; NOT the words for 'reconsider' or 'inventory'

mnemonic: 혼동 = 혼합 (mixing) + 동일 (same): mixing two things up until they seem the same. 혼돈 is a world without order.

collocations.en: to be easy to mix up

examples.ko: '결재'와 '결제'는 발음이 같아서 혼동하기 쉽다.
examples.en: 결재 and 결제 sound the same, so they're easy to mix up.

examples.ko: 두 회사의 로고가 너무 비슷해서 소비자들에게 혼동을 줄 우려가 있다.
examples.en: The two companies' logos are so alike that consumers may confuse them.

production.promptEn: confusion (mixing up A with B); a mix-up
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; NOT the near-homophone meaning 'chaos'

mnemonic: 혼돈 is chaos, the formless soup before creation (혼돈의 시대). 혼동 is mixing up two particular things (A와 B를 혼동하다).

examples.ko: 정권이 무너진 뒤 그 나라는 한동안 깊은 혼돈에 빠졌다.
examples.en: After the regime fell, the country sank into deep chaos for a time.

examples.ko: 이사 첫날 우리 집은 그야말로 혼돈 그 자체였다.
examples.en: On moving day our place was sheer chaos.

production.promptEn: chaos; disorder
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean noun; NOT the near-homophone meaning 'mixing two things up'

mnemonic: 녹록: small, ordinary pebbles, easy to step over. Life, it turns out, is 녹록지 않다.
meanings: easy to deal with, a pushover

examples.ko: 청년들이 혼자 힘으로 집을 마련하기란 결코 녹록지 않다.
examples.en: It's no easy matter for young people to get a home on their own.

examples.ko: 상대 팀이 생각보다 녹록지 않네. 긴장 좀 해야겠어.
examples.en: The other team is tougher than I thought. We need to stay sharp.

production.promptEn: easy to handle, a pushover (almost always negated: ___지 않다, 'no easy matter')

mnemonic: 깜냥: the size of the load you can actually carry, not the one you wish you could.

collocations.en: to not be up to it

examples.ko: 팀장 자리는 솔직히 내 깜냥으로는 감당이 안 될 것 같아.
examples.en: Honestly, I don't think I'm up to being team leader.

examples.ko: 그는 자기 깜냥도 모르고 큰 사업에 덤볐다가 빚만 졌다.
examples.en: Without knowing his own limits, he plunged into a big venture and ended up deep in debt.

production.promptEn: one's capacity / what one can handle (often said modestly)

mnemonic: 지레 jumps the gun: scared, certain, or giving up before anything has happened.

examples.ko: 해 보지도 않고 지레 겁먹을 필요는 없어.
examples.en: There's no need to get scared before you've even tried.

examples.ko: 그는 상대가 거절할 거라고 지레짐작하고 아예 제안을 하지 않았다.
examples.en: Assuming the other side would refuse, he never even made the offer.

production.promptEn: prematurely; in advance (before there's any reason to)

mnemonic: 고스란히: the cake carried across the room without losing a single crumb.

examples.ko: 할머니가 쓰시던 방은 돌아가신 뒤에도 고스란히 남아 있었다.
examples.en: Grandmother's room stayed untouched even after she passed away.

examples.ko: 원자재 값이 오른 부담은 고스란히 소비자에게 돌아갔다.
examples.en: The entire burden of higher raw-material prices was passed straight on to consumers.

production.promptEn: intact, untouched; (passed on) undiminished

mnemonic: 아우르다: an arm around everyone in the photo, every generation in one frame.

examples.ko: 그 가수의 노래는 세대를 아우르는 인기를 누리고 있다.
examples.en: The singer's songs are popular across generations.

examples.ko: 이번 전시는 회화와 사진, 영상을 아우르는 대규모 기획전이다.
examples.en: This is a large-scale exhibition spanning painting, photography, and video.

production.promptEn: to encompass / bring together (groups, genres, or generations)

mnemonic: 북받치다: something pushing up from deep in the chest until it's caught in your throat.

collocations.en: a wave of hurt wells up

examples.ko: 수상 소감을 말하던 그는 감정이 북받쳐 끝내 말을 잇지 못했다.
examples.en: Giving his acceptance speech, he was overcome with emotion and couldn't go on.

examples.ko: 엄마 목소리를 듣자마자 서러움이 북받쳐서 엉엉 울었어.
examples.en: The moment I heard Mom's voice, all the hurt welled up and I sobbed.

production.promptEn: (of emotion) to well up; to be overcome

mnemonic: 사그라들다: embers settling into ash, one soft hiss at a time.

examples.ko: 한때 뜨거웠던 투자 열기가 금리 인상과 함께 빠르게 사그라들었다.
examples.en: The once red-hot investment fever quickly died down as interest rates rose.

examples.ko: 화가 좀 사그라들면 그때 다시 얘기하자.
examples.en: Let's talk again once you've cooled down a bit.

production.promptEn: to die down; subside (fire, anger, enthusiasm)

mnemonic: 얼렁뚱땅: a quick shuffle of the cards so no one looks too closely.
meanings: glossing over (to get away with it)

examples.ko: 실수를 얼렁뚱땅 넘기려다가 오히려 일이 커졌다.
examples.en: He tried to fudge his way past the mistake, and it only blew up.

examples.ko: 숙제를 얼렁뚱땅 해 가면 선생님이 다 알아.
examples.en: If you do your homework any old way, the teacher can tell.

production.promptEn: sloppily, slapdash (fudging something to get it over with or get away with it)

mnemonic: 시답잖다 comes from 실답지 않다: nothing 실 (solid, substantial) about it.

examples.ko: 다들 바쁜데 시답잖은 얘기로 회의 시간을 잡아먹지 맙시다.
examples.en: Everyone's busy, so let's not eat up meeting time with trivial chatter.

examples.ko: 걔는 내 고민을 시답잖다는 듯이 듣더라.
examples.en: He listened to my worries as if they were hardly worth bothering about.

production.promptEn: trivial, not worth bothering with (silly, lame)

mnemonic: 하물며 raises the stakes: 'if even X…, then how much more Y.'

examples.ko: 전문가도 풀기 어려운 문제인데 하물며 초보자야 오죽하겠는가.
examples.en: It's a hard problem even for experts, let alone for a beginner.

examples.ko: 평소에도 주차할 데가 없는 동넨데, 하물며 명절 연휴야 말할 것도 없지.
examples.en: It's hard to find parking around here on a normal day, let alone over the holidays.

production.promptEn: let alone; much less (all the more so)

mnemonic: 버젓이: standing up straight in broad daylight, as if nothing were wrong.

examples.ko: 단속이 끝나자 불법 노점들이 다시 버젓이 영업을 시작했다.
examples.en: As soon as the crackdown ended, the illegal street stalls brazenly reopened.

examples.ko: 증거가 다 있는데도 버젓이 거짓말을 하더라.
examples.en: Even with all the evidence there, he lied to my face.

production.promptEn: brazenly, openly (without shame or concealment)

mnemonic: 서슴다 = to hesitate; 서슴없이 = with zero hesitation.

examples.ko: 그는 질문을 받자 서슴없이 자신의 실수를 인정했다.
examples.en: When asked, he admitted his mistake without hesitation.

examples.ko: 모르는 게 있으면 서슴없이 물어보세요.
examples.en: If there's anything you don't know, don't hesitate to ask.

production.promptEn: without hesitation; unhesitatingly
production.contextHint: native adverb; from 서슴다 'to hesitate'. Nothing in the way (unstoppable) is 거침없이

mnemonic: 애먼: the bystander who catches the punch meant for someone else.

collocations.en: to take it out on the wrong person

examples.ko: 근거 없는 소문 때문에 애먼 사람이 피해를 봤다.
examples.en: Because of a baseless rumor, an innocent person got hurt.

examples.ko: 회사에서 깨지고 와서 왜 애먼 나한테 화풀이야?
examples.en: You got chewed out at work, so why take it out on me?

production.promptEn: innocent / the wrong (person): someone who doesn't deserve the blame or harm

mnemonic: 들추다: lifting the lid to see what's hidden underneath.

collocations.en: to dig up, bring to light

examples.ko: 청문회에서 야당 의원들은 후보자의 오래된 비리를 하나하나 들춰냈다.
examples.en: At the hearing, opposition lawmakers dug up the nominee's old misdeeds one by one.

examples.ko: 이미 끝난 얘기를 왜 자꾸 들추는 거야?
examples.en: Why do you keep raking up something that's already settled?

production.promptEn: to dig up / rake up (past faults or secrets); to rummage through

mnemonic: 떠 (lift off) + 넘기다 (hand over): lift the load off your own back and over onto someone else's.
meanings: to dump (a task or blame) on

collocations.en: to pass the buck back and forth

examples.ko: 팀장은 자기가 저지른 실수를 막내에게 떠넘겼다.
examples.en: The team lead pinned his own mistake on the most junior member.

examples.ko: 하기 싫은 일을 나한테 떠넘기지 마.
examples.en: Don't dump the jobs you don't want on me.

production.promptEn: to foist / dump (a task, blame, or burden) onto someone else
production.contextHint: native verb; everyday counterpart of 전가하다
